# Code Anchors: Page Paths

- `src/app/routes.tsx` — maps the nine page paths to pages and replaces an unknown path with List
- `src/main.tsx` — starts the router over the route table
- `firebase.json` — hosting rewrite that answers every page path with the app, except Firebase's reserved paths
- `vite.config.ts` — offline navigation fallback of the installed app, with the same reserved-path exception
- `src/components/NotFound.tsx` — the "not found" message with its control to the parent page
- `src/app/navigation.test.tsx` — tests reload, saved links, unknown paths and the fallback rules
- `docs/system/stack.md` — records React Router as the routing library
